title: B2B Website Contact, Social Links & Tech Stack Enricher Input

startUrls.title: Target Company URLs
startUrls.description: List of company or e-commerce website URLs to enrich with contact details, social links, JSON-LD metadata, and tech stack fingerprints.

maxItems.title: Max Domains to Enrich
maxItems.description: Maximum number of target company URLs to process in a single run (Free-tier Apify runs are capped at 25 results).

followContactPages.title: Crawl Internal /contact and /about Pages
followContactPages.description: Automatically discover and fetch up to 2 internal Contact or About pages per domain to maximize email and phone coverage.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrent Requests
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel async HTTP requests.
